item.title: FRANK BELLO Says His Grandmother's Final Show Was ANTHRAX At Yankee Stadium: 'She Loved It'
item.description: Anthrax bassist Frank Bello has shared a personal memory from one of the biggest shows of his career, the Big Four concert at Yankee Stadium in 2011.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says DAVE MUSTAINE ‘Hated Playing Before SLAYER’ On 2010 Tour
item.description: Dave Mustaine wasn’t happy with his spot on the lineup during MEGADETH’s tours with SLAYER, according to former bandmate David Ellefson. In a recent episode of The David Ellefson Show podcast (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH), the former MEGADETH bassist spoke about the 2010 Jägermeister Music Tour.
